attackers_goals: Gain access to Google Workspace data and services. Collect confidential information from Google Workspace. Compromise user accounts and data.
description: A domain administrator authorized a third-party application to access the Google Workspace APIs. This allows the application to interact with the domain user's data within the authorized scope, as specified in the API call.
detection_modules: Identity Threat Module, SaaS Threat Detection
investigative_actions: Check which account was granted access to the Domain API. Identify the source IP address of the request. Verify the legitimacy of the request.
name: A third-party application was authorized to access the Google Workspace APIs
